tasks.label: Validate DISC login and production build
args: $nodeDir=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\node-v24.20.0-win-x64'; $env:PATH="$nodeDir;$env:PATH"; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run lint; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run build; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Inspect Next dev CSS asset
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; Get-ChildItem .next\static\css -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; Get-Content package.json | Select-String '"dev"|"build"'

tasks.label: Inspect Next dev listener and CSS
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen | Format-Table LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; Get-ChildItem .next\static\css -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table Name,Length

tasks.label: Identify development server process
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId = 2524' | Format-List ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine; Get-ChildItem .next\static\css\app -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table FullName,Length

tasks.label: Identify Next listener process
args: Get-Process -Id 2524 | Format-List Id,ProcessName,Path; Get-ChildItem .next\static\css\app -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table FullName,Length

tasks.label: Verify DISC server response
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen | Format-Table LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess; Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:3000/login -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object StatusCode

tasks.label: Build consolidated Supabase SQL
args: $files = @("supabase/migrations/001_disc_schema.sql", "supabase/migrations/002_roles_and_teams.sql", "supabase/migrations/003_questionnaires_campaigns.sql", "supabase/migrations/004_domain_operations.sql", "supabase/migrations/005_employee_directory.sql", "supabase/migrations/006_employee_directory_work_fields.sql", "supabase/migrations/007_fix_assessment_completion_order.sql", "supabase/migrations/008_results_dashboard_access.sql", "supabase/seed.sql"); $builder = [System.Text.StringBuilder]::new(); [void]$builder.AppendLine("-- People Insights: complete Supabase setup for a new project."); [void]$builder.AppendLine("-- Run once in Supabase SQL Editor. Includes employee directory and the initial DISC questionnaire and campaign seed."); [void]$builder.AppendLine("-- Do not run on a database where these migrations have already been applied."); foreach ($file in $files) { [void]$builder.AppendLine(); [void]$builder.AppendLine("-- ===== $file ====="); [void]$builder.AppendLine(); [void]$builder.Append([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $PWD $file))); [void]$builder.AppendLine(); }; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD "supabase/setup.sql"), $builder.ToString(), [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); Get-Item supabase/setup.sql | Format-Table Name,Length
